rows.weakness: P1 — the whole page dies. `(function initSync(){...})` calls `window.claude.use("db").then(...)` at html:6921 with NO try/catch; only the promise is `.catch()`ed. A SYNCHRONOUS throw from claude.use propagates out of the IIFE and halts every remaining top-level statement, so 0 of 318 containers render — a blank dashboard, exactly the 2026-09-03 CI-log regression class. Exception: claude.use('db') exploded (injected failure) @ html:6921. Fix: wrap the use() call in try/catch and fall back to setSyncStatus("Local only (this device)","off").
